facts.summary: Positive blinded interim remission data, no stock-drop cause stated · Phase 2/3 · Annamycin plus cytarabine in relapsed/refractory AML · not yet approved
facts.indication: relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia

evidence.summary: With 62 subjects evaluable to date, the preliminary blinded complete remission (CR) rate is 24% and the composite complete remission (CRc) rate is 37%.
evidence.safety: based on reported ejection fractions and adverse events, we continue to observe no evidence of cardiotoxicity
